messages:
sam: Quick preflight — listing SKU landed in the cloud marketplace staging catalog. Two asks: 1) hardware partner needs a reserved rack slot for demo (EdgeCloud asked for 3U) 2) press kit link goes to partners before embargo? timeline check.

lina: Re: hardware slot 1: EdgeCloud confirmed 3U reserved in rack A7 for Thursday demo. I'll email logistics contact.

kai: Press kit: we have a partner-only folder with logos and screenshots. embargo plan is 08:00 PT embargo lift, public blog at 08:05 PT. partners get the kit at T-30m via secure share. Is that acceptable?

sam: T-30m sounds good. Make sure the partner kit has the hero screenshot in 2:1 and 16:9 variants and both PNG + SVG. Also include CDN cache bust query param for last-minute edits.

lina: Will add assets. Also flag: landing page A/B test toggles are on. We need to decide CTA variant: "Try in Marketplace" vs "Launch Demo". Ops wants consistent CTA in partner listing.

kai: Ops-bot, what's the rollout window and health gating?

ops-bot: Rollout window scheduled 08:00-08:20 PT. Health gate: if listing success rate < 98% or page load median > 800ms for 5m, trigger rollback to previous bundle and notify eng-oncall + partner-ops. CDN invalidation job queued at T+2m after publish.

sam: Good. Lina, prefer Test A = "Try in Marketplace" for partner UX parity. I'll approve A unless legal pushes back.

lina: Noted. Adding to the content freeze doc and pinging legal.

kai: SI integration note: connectors in staging hit a per-file timeout at 45s. Increased retry backoff and chunking recommended. I've updated the SI onboarding sheet and added a troubleshooting section for chunked uploads. Partners should run connector smoke at 10:00 PT and paste logs in this thread.

sam: Pushed a commit to infra repo referencing the marketplace listing deployment: commit 6b3f2d. Ops-bot, will the rollback preserve partner provisioning state?

ops-bot: Rollback policy: listing UI rollback will not revert provisioning records. Provisioning reverts require manual DB rollback request from partner-ops. Auto-fallback for customer-facing flows will route to "basic-listing" variant to avoid signup loss.

kai: Press-bot, can you confirm embargo lift notifications to press and partners?

press-bot: Embargo notifications scheduled: partners at T-30m via secure share; press distribution at T via secure PRWire and targeted reporters. Press release file: https://files.redwood/co/press-kit/5801239999.zip. Reminder: no quote edits after embargo lift.

lina: Small thing: Campaign UTMs added: utm_medium=marketplace, utm_source=partner-ecosys, utm_campaign=may_launch. Analytics will track partner-referrals separately.

sam: If everyone is green, we'll hold final go/no-go check at 07:30 PT. Please post single-word thumbs here (yes/no/blocker).

lina: yes :white_check_mark:

kai: yes :thumbsup:

sam: Thanks team 1. If any partner reports blockers during their 10:00 smoke, escalate to #support immediately.
